gloss: person who sees someone off; well-wisher at a departure

definitions.gloss: person who sees someone off; well-wisher
definitions.explanation: A person who goes to see off a traveler or guest at a station, airport, or port to bid them farewell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見送|みおく}り{人|にん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: The well-wishers gathered at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見送|みおく}り{人|にん}がいた。
examples.english: There were many people seeing them off at the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出航|しゅっこう}→出航：30231_shukkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}、{見送|みおく}り{人|にん}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}っていた→振る：01983_furu⟧。
examples.english: As the ship set sail, the well-wishers waved from the shore.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{見送|みおく}り→見送り：03742_miokuri⟧ (seeing off) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). Refers to those who come to bid farewell to a departing traveler.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見送|みおく}り{人|にん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: well-wishers gather
- ⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見送|みおく}り{人|にん}: a large crowd seeing (someone) off

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見送|みおく}り→見送り：03742_miokuri⟧: a send-off — the act itself rather than the person
- ⟦{出迎|でむか}え→出迎える：04633_demukaeru⟧: meeting, welcoming — the opposite, greeting an arrival
